subject: Globex / Redwood - Access enablement kickoff (SSO, SCIM, IP allowlist)
messages:
From: Alice Wu <alice.wu@globex.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: it-admin@globex.com
Date: 2026-10-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Globex / Redwood - Access enablement kickoff (SSO, SCIM, IP allowlist)

Hi Rachel & team,

Thanks again for the product demo yesterday — we were impressed with the latency numbers and the dedicated deployment options. We'd like to kick off the access enablement workstream so our SSO, SCIM provisioning, IP allowlisting, and service account patterns are ready for the pilot. High-level asks from our security team: 

- SAML integration (IdP metadata + attribute map)
- SCIM provisioning for employee and contractor groups (which attributes are required)
- IP allowlist for Redwood's egress and callback endpoints (we'll provide ranges)
- Service accounts for automation (least privilege scopes + rotation cadence)

We are targeting a pilot on 2026-11-02. Can you share a mutual action plan and an internal RACI for implementation tasks? Also please point us to any SOC2 or audit evidence relevant to account provisioning.

Attaching: globex_initial_requirements.xlsx (internal) — will follow with a security questionnaire next week.

Best,
Alice Wu
Head of Identity & Security
Globex Corporation
From: rachel.kim@redwood.com <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@globex.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-12T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Globex / Redwood - Access enablement kickoff (SSO, SCIM, IP allowlist)

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear asks and the timing. We've sketched a short mutual action plan and a concise SSO/SCIM/IP checklist to align our teams before the pilot.

Summary of our proposal (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff, share MAP, collect IdP metadata + SCIM group mapping
- Week 1: Redwood infra provides SAML SP metadata and test endpoints; engineering to validate SSO test users
- Week 2: SCIM attribute mapping + provisioning smoke test for contractors
- Week 3: IP allowlist verification (test callbacks) + create service accounts with scoped keys; rotate policy documented
- Week of pilot: dry-run + cutover window and rollback steps

I've attached: sso_scim_checklist.pdf and globex_mutual_action_plan.xlsx.

Quick Qs from our side:
1) Do you have a preferred SAML attribute for canonical employee id (emp_id vs mail)?
2) Which contractor groups should be excluded from automatic SCIM deprovisioning?
3) Can your infra team accept callback IP ranges in CIDR blocks, or do you require individual IPs?

I'll loop in Ben (CS) to coordinate schedules and Marissa for any SLA/exception approvals.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Operational items (CS / onboarding):
- Proposed kickoff: 2026-10-15 10:00 AM PT (30-45m) — agenda: IdP exchange, SCIM mapping sheet review, test account plan
- Test accounts: we recommend two persistent test users (one employee, one contractor) + one ephemeral service acct for automation testing
- Service account pattern: name: redwood-globex-sa-<env>, scopes: [provision:read, provision:write, admin:limited] (we'll provide a least-privilege example)
- Audit evidence: I'll attach a short pack with our provisioning logs retention policy and a sample audit export (see Drive link).

Links: 
- MAP: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3CdefGHIJ
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/98821

I'll prepare the test plan doc and drop it in the Drive folder before kickoff.

Cheers,

Looping in a couple of managerial notes so the team is clear on boundaries:

- SLA / exceptions: any request to relax IP allowlisting for debugging must go through security@redwood with a timeboxed approval (max 4 hours). Please capture requests in the MAP and we'll approve case-by-case.
- Escalation path: if the pilot shows auth regressions that block customer-critical flows, escalate to Marissa Cole (me) and our Platform on-call (listed in the MAP).
- Compliance artifacts: Rachel / Ben, make sure the sample audit export includes the provisioning event schema (user.created, user.scim_sync, user.deprovision). Security may ask for raw timestamps during audits.

Thanks — keep the communication tight and we'll review the dry-run results before the cutover.

Thanks everyone — that plan looks good. A couple of specifics from our infra team: 

- SAML: we will use employeeNumber as the canonical emp id; metadata URL: https://idp.globex.com/metadata.xml (we will share the full metadata in a follow-up email).
- SCIM: include attributes: userName, givenName, familyName, emails, employeeType, employeeNumber, manager. Contractor groups: globex_contractors (exclude from auto-deprovision)
- IPs: we can accept CIDR ranges. Primary callback ranges: 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.16/28
- Service accounts: prefer JSON keys with KMS-wrapped secrets; rotation cadence: 90 days.

We'll accept the kickoff on 2026-10-15 10:00 AM PT. I'll have our IdP admin (it-admin@globex.com) on the call and will drop the metadata and the filled SCIM mapping sheet prior to the meeting.

On the attachments: please confirm you received globex_mutual_action_plan.xlsx and sso_scim_checklist.pdf and that you uploaded the audit evidence sample to the Drive link.

Regards,
Alice
